examples.code:
import { Grid, GridSystem, GridCell } from '@vercel/geistcn/components';
import type { JSX } from 'react';

export function Component(): JSX.Element {
  return (
    <GridSystem unstable_useContainer>
      <Grid columns={12} rows={3}>
        <GridCell column="1/3" row="1/3" solid>
          1
        </GridCell>
        <GridCell column="2/4" row="2/4">
          2
        </GridCell>
        <GridCell column="3/10" row="2/4">
          Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed at felis
        </GridCell>
        <GridCell column="7/12" row="1/-1" solid>
          3
        </GridCell>
        <GridCell column="11/13" row="1/3" solid>
          4
        </GridCell>
      </Grid>
    </GridSystem>
  );
}

examples.heading: Specific Grid with Guide Clipping
examples.description: Grid component with guide clipping enabled on specific cells.
examples.code:
import { Grid, GridSystem, GridCell } from '@vercel/geistcn/components';
import type { JSX } from 'react';

export function Component(): JSX.Element {
  return (
    <GridSystem guideWidth={1} unstable_useContainer>
      <Grid columns={3} rows={4}>
        <GridCell column="1/2" row="1/3" solid>
          1
        </GridCell>
        <GridCell column="3/4" row="1/2" solid>
          2
        </GridCell>
        <GridCell column="2/3" row="2/4">
          3
        </GridCell>
        <GridCell column="1/2" row="4/5" solid>
          4
        </GridCell>
        <GridCell column="3/4" row="3/5" solid>
          5
        </GridCell>
      </Grid>
    </GridSystem>
  );
}

Contained grid
examples.description: A Grid with its own useContainer prop: the section carries the container class, so its breakpoint rules read the wrapper width through container queries. The docs render no such grid; the class string comes from the component client code.

examples.heading: Dashed grid
examples.description: A Grid with its own dashedGuides prop: every guide carries the dashed class. The docs render no such grid; the class string comes from the component client code.

examples.heading: Grid page with banner
examples.description: A GridPage with a banner: the page keeps no top padding for the banner's height at the lg breakpoint (the `lg:first:pt-0` utility replaces the banner-height one). The docs render no banner; the class strings come from the component's client code.
